findings.text: The new condition forces x64 only for versions below 14.17.0 and for 15.x. Versions 14.17.0 to 14.x on darwin/arm64 now keep arm64, but the comment itself says no darwin-arm64 binaries exist before v16. Running `nvm install 14.21.3` on an M1 Mac will build a darwin-arm64 download URL that 404s. Before this change it fell back to x64 and worked.

The helper `nvm_version_greater_than_or_equal_to` is called but I found no definition of it in the searched directory. If it is not defined elsewhere in nvm.sh, the call fails. The `||` branch would then be false for all 15.x versions, so they would keep arm64 and break.
